Diego Hassan
diego.hassan@example.com | Tampa, FL
Diego Hassan has 8 years of experience in backend and distributed systems. Most
recently, Senior Backend Engineer at Slate Labs (2025-2026), where they led
migration of core services at Slate Labs onto AWS, improving uptime during peak
load. Before that, Backend Engineer at Grayline Software (2024-2025). Before
that, Software Engineer I at Northbeam Networks (2018-2024). Education: B.S.
Electrical Engineering, NC State University, 2018. Core skills: AWS, Java,
Terraform, REST API design, GraphQL, Kubernetes, CI/CD, PostgreSQL, TypeScript,
Distributed systems.
